sourceEvidence.quote:
The Director, Site Operations is responsible for the overall operational performance, reliability, and leadership at a center campus, ensuring all critical infrastructure and supporting teams operate safely and effectively in a 24x7x365 mission-critical environment. This role holds full accountability for site operations across power, cooling, building control systems, and facility spaces, with a primary focus on safety, reliability, risk management, and operational excellence.

This leader sets the vision and operational standards for the site by aligning people, processes, and priorities to deliver consistent performance and exceptional customer confidence. The Director, Site Operations oversees maintenance strategy, system readiness, and disciplined execution of preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs while maintaining strict adherence to safety and compliance standards.

The Director provides leadership to Operations Managers, Critical Facilities Engineers, and contracted service partners, fostering a culture of accountability, technical rigor, and continuous improvement. This role ensures teams are properly trained, resourced, and aligned to meet both daily operational demands and long-term site objectives.
